subject: Post-demo: risk acceptance path, stakeholder roles & next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medsys.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: risk acceptance path, stakeholder roles & next steps

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a proposed path forward so we keep momentum: 

1) Stakeholder map (as discussed)
   - Economic buyer: Jordan Lee (VP Ops) — budget decision by 12/10
   - Security / risk owner: Mindy Zhao (Dir, InfoSec) — security review and evidence request
   - Procurement: procurement@medsys.com — standard T&Cs + SOW cadence
   - Clinical champion / influencer: Elena Park (Clinical Informatics) — POC success criteria

2) Primary decision criteria you described
   - Data residency + audit trail (log retention 2+ years)
   - Predictable latency under production load (95th pct target)
   - Integration with your SSO and KMS
   - Clear economics for pilot -> production (unit cost targets)

3) Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm/update):
   - We’ll send a risk acceptance matrix that maps gaps to mitigations (Hannah) — delivery by EOD Mon 11/23
   - Mindy: if you can share the top 5 security artifacts you need, we’ll map them to our pack
   - Procurement: if we can get a vendor intake form or procurement checklist, Sergio will align pricing and SOW
   - Laura will draft a 6-week pilot MxP (mutual action plan) for review

Attachments: demo recording + initial risk matrix stub.

If this looks right, can you confirm the timeline for legal review (target week of 11/30) and procurement intake? Happy to host a short call with Mindy and procurement to walk the risk matrix.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: risk acceptance path, stakeholder roles & next steps

Hannah — appreciated the demo and the summary. A couple quick items from our side: 

- Timeline: legal review target is realistically 11/30–12/03; procurement intake will be ready by 11/27 (we run vendor forms on Fridays).
- Mindy / InfoSec will need SOC 2 Type II report, data retention policy, and an architecture diagram showing KMS flow. Mindy — confirming that list?
- On risk acceptance: we can evaluate mitigations vs. controls matrix, but executive sign-off will need a brief memo (I can pull that together once we have the mapped gaps).

We’re also curious about the pilot economics: what does a 6-week pilot look like cost-wise and what guardrails exist to limit spend? Please send a pricing sketch and we’ll route to procurement.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee | VP Operations, MedSys Health
jordan.lee@medsys.com | +1 (617) 555-0921

Mindy — if you can confirm the top 5 artifacts you need by EOD Tue 11/24, we’ll prioritize them in the evidence pack. Happy to set a 30-minute walkthrough with our security engineer next Wed (11/25) if helpful.
